title: Going through Texas names: Chilly Jim, Crip John, Baby Lewis
summary: Interviewer reads a list of Texas musicians; Albert mostly did not know them, remembers drummer Baby Lewis.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, I told Frank I didn't know about that.
Yeah. And Chris in the Mention Hall?
You know that place? Which one? Chris. Chris. C-R-S.
The Flores in Houston. No, that was before I came. And the Benedict Donk on Matamara Street. Oh, this is way before I came. Yeah, I see.
And they mentioned Chilly Jim of Waco. I think he plays piano much. I think that's another one. Yeah.
Clem Nurse, did you know him? No. Big Boi Whopper on Cherokee Church.
No, Baby Lewis. No, Baby Lewis. All this is way before I came. Yeah, I see.
And they mentioned Chili Jim of Waco. I think he plays piano much.
Clem Nurse, did you know him? No. Big Boy Warford on the car now? No.
Crip John who played valve thrombones?
No. All of these guys are playing in front of me.
No, Baby Lewis, well I remember him, but that's after he got out of this deal, I saw Baby Lewis in Dallas. He was a good drummer.
